shareLink.sub: Anyone with this link from a verified domain can join as a Member. Disable any time.

teams.title: Teams
teams.subtitle: Group people for ownership routing, notifications, and review assignment.
teams.subtitleReal: Group people within the organization. Assign ownership and review routing in workspace settings.

empty.title: No teams yet
empty.subtitle: Create a team to group members.

removeDialog.title: Delete {{name}}?
removeDialog.description: Members keep their org access. Code paths owned by this team revert to org default routing.
removeDialog.descriptionReal: Members stay in the organization; only the team grouping is removed.

detail.noMembers: No members yet. Add someone to start routing work here.
detail.codeOwnershipPre: Globs that route reviews and incidents to this team. Paths flagged Auto are added to

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: Built-in roles are locked. Duplicate one to define a custom role tuned to your team.
roles.describePlaceholder: Describe what this role is for…
roles.lockNotice: This is a built-in role and cannot be edited. Duplicate it to make a customized version.
roles.footer: Custom roles take effect immediately for assigned members. Audit log records every permission change.

seed.owner: Full access. Can transfer ownership and delete the org.
seed.admin: Manage members, workspaces, and policies. No billing.
seed.member: Default role. Use the product, ship code, run agents.
seed.billing: Read-only access except for billing surfaces.
seed.secops: Custom — security review and audit access.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Org-wide controls. Stricter settings here override per-user choices.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.hint: How people prove who they are when signing in.
auth.mfaRequiredSub: All members must enroll a second factor before they can access the org.
auth.mfaMethodSub: Restrict to a specific factor type, or accept any enrolled factor.
auth.passkeyAdminsSub: Owners and Admins must use a phishing-resistant factor (WebAuthn).
auth.ssoOnlySub: Block password & social login. Members must use the org IdP.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.hint: How long an authenticated browser stays signed in.
sessions.maxDurationSub: Hard cap. After this, the user is logged out and must re-authenticate.
sessions.inactivitySub: Sign out after this many minutes of no activity.
sessions.rememberMeSub: Lets users skip MFA on trusted browsers for up to 30 days.
sessions.trustDevicesSub: Treat enrolled devices as a second factor on subsequent sign-ins.

ipAllowlist.title: IP allowlist
ipAllowlist.hint: Restrict org access to a specific set of CIDR blocks. Empty list = allow all.
ipAllowlist.empty: No CIDRs yet. Add one to start enforcing.
ipAllowlist.lockoutWarn: Make sure your current IP is included before saving — otherwise you'll lock yourself out.
ipAllowlist.off: IP allowlisting is off. Members can sign in from any network.

appAccess.title: App access
appAccess.hint: Who can connect third-party OAuth apps to the org.
appAccess.installSub: Members can browse the directory but only allowed roles can install.

notes.effect: Changes take effect immediately for new sign-ins. Existing sessions live until next refresh.
notes.notify: Members are notified by email when MFA, SSO-only, or passkey requirements change.
notes.recovery: Recovery codes are reissued whenever the MFA method changes.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: {{installed}} of {{total}} apps installed.
integrations.noMatchSub: Try a different category or clear the search.

blurb.slack: Post review requests, agent updates, and incident signal to channels.
blurb.jira: Two-way sync between admission gates and Jira tickets.
blurb.linear: Open Linear issues from review threads. Link PRs back to issues.
blurb.pagerduty: Page on-call when admission rules block a deploy or an agent crashes.
blurb.datadog: Send agent + admission metrics to Datadog. Scrape errors back into incidents.
blurb.github: Pull repos, post check runs, and apply CODEOWNERS routing.
blurb.gitlab: Same as GitHub, for GitLab-hosted projects.
blurb.notion: Surface investigation summaries and runbooks inside Notion docs.
blurb.sentry: Cross-link errors with admission failures and post-mortems.
blurb.discord: Drop notifications into a Discord server channel.

drawer.errorNotice: API key returned 401 on last poll. Reconnect to refresh credentials.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: HTTP callbacks fired from org-level events. Each endpoint can subscribe to a subset of event types.
webhooks.subtitleReal: HTTP callbacks fired from org events, signed with HMAC-SHA256. Each endpoint subscribes to a subset of events.

empty.endpointsSub: Add an endpoint to receive signed event callbacks.
empty.deliveriesSub: Events will show here once endpoints receive them.

signingSecret.title: Signing secret
signingSecret.description: Verify each delivery's x-p0-signature header (HMAC-SHA256 of the body) with this secret. Shown once.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this endpoint?
deleteDialog.description: It will immediately stop receiving events. Delivery history is retained.

api.title: API & OAuth
api.subtitle: Org-scoped credentials and OAuth applications. Personal tokens live under /me/api-tokens.
api.footer: Tokens authenticate as the org. Anything they do is auditable but not always reversible.

deleteDialog.patDescription: Any client using this token will start getting 401 immediately. This action cannot be undone.
deleteDialog.appDescription: Existing OAuth installs will be invalidated. Users will be prompted to reauthorize on next sign-in.

pat.empty: No tokens yet. Create one to authenticate machine clients to the org API.

policies.title: Policies
policies.subtitle: Org-default admission rules. Workspaces inherit these; per-workspace settings can override unless locked.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.hint: How org defaults reach existing and new workspaces.
inheritance.applyNewSub: Whenever a workspace is created, copy the active org rules and enforce them by default.
inheritance.pushExistingSub: When a rule changes here, propagate the new severity to every workspace that hasn't customized it locally.

rules.title: Rules
rules.hint: Each rule has a single severity. Block fails the gate; warn surfaces a soft signal.

override.desc2Approvers: Production branches need at least two human approvals. Owners count once.

policies.footer: Saved changes appear in the workspace admission view within seconds. Active fix-pipeline runs are not retroactively re-checked.

aiPolicies.title: AI policies
aiPolicies.subtitle: Which models the org can use, where data lives, and how prompts are sanitized before they leave the org.

allowedModels.title: Allowed models
allowedModels.hint: Members can only pick from this list. Disabling a model immediately stops in-flight runs from queuing follow-ups.
allowedModels.conflict_one: {{count}} selected model is not available in the chosen residency. Members will get an error on use.
allowedModels.conflict_other: {{count}} selected models are not available in the chosen residency. Members will get an error on use.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.hint: What members get if they don't pick a model. Must be in the allowed list above.
defaults.fastModelSub: For bulk / background work (admission, agents). Pick a fast tier for cost.
defaults.reviewerOverrideSub: If on, individual reviewers can pick a non-default model for one-off review runs.

dataHandling.title: Data handling
dataHandling.hint: What providers can do with org prompts, and where they live.
dataHandling.optOutSub: Tell the provider not to use any prompt / completion for fine-tuning.
dataHandling.residencySub: Models will only be routed to inference endpoints in the chosen region.
dataHandling.retentionSub: How many days the provider keeps prompts in their logs.

promptSafety.title: Prompt safety
promptSafety.hint: Pre-send filters applied to every prompt that leaves the org.
promptSafety.redactSubPre: Run the secret scanner against every prompt and replace matches with
promptSafety.blockPiiSub: Refuse to send a prompt that contains PII (emails, SSNs, credit cards, phone numbers).

agentCaps.title: Agent capabilities
agentCaps.hint: What autonomous agents are allowed to do on behalf of the org.
agentCaps.browsingSub: Allow agents to fetch external URLs as part of investigations.
agentCaps.toolUseSub: Allow function-calling against internal tools (admission, fix-pipeline, audit).

spendCap.title: Spend cap
spendCap.hint: Hard limit on monthly token spend. Org gets paused on cap; admins are paged.
spendCap.monthlyCapSub: Counted across every allowed model. 0 disables the cap.

notes.changes: Changes apply on the next agent / chat invocation.
notes.retention: Existing prompts already at the provider follow whatever retention was in force when they were sent.
notes.audit: Audit log records who changed what, every time. Reviewers can re-read decisions back to a configuration snapshot.

samlSso.title: SAML SSO
samlSso.subtitle: Configure SAML 2.0 single sign-on with your identity provider.

status.connectedSub: SAML SSO is active and healthy.
status.notConfiguredSub: Fill in IdP metadata below to get started.

idp.title: Identity provider metadata
idp.hint: Paste values from your IdP, or upload the metadata XML to autofill.

sp.title: Service provider metadata
sp.hint: Paste these into your IdP when creating the SAML application.

mapping.title: Attribute mapping
mapping.hint: Map SAML assertion claims onto the user profile fields.

enforcement.title: Enforcement
enforcement.hint: Tighten how the org uses SSO.
enforcement.requireSsoSub: Block password and social login. Members must sign in via your IdP.
enforcement.jitSub: Auto-create accounts on first SSO sign-in. Otherwise users must be pre-invited.

notes.test: Always test the connection in an incognito window before requiring SSO — misconfigured IdPs can lock everyone out.
notes.recovery: Owners can always sign in with a recovery code if SSO breaks.

sso.title: SAML / SSO
sso.subtitle: Connect your OIDC identity provider. Users whose email domain matches are routed to your IdP at login. Enterprise plan.
sso.verifiedProven: Ownership of {{domain}} is proven — matching logins route to your IdP.
sso.verifyPrompt1: Add this TXT record at the root of
sso.verifyPrompt3: routed to your IdP until the domain is verified.
sso.dnsNotFound: TXT record not found yet — DNS can take a few minutes to propagate.
sso.auditNote: Only owners/admins can change this. Every change is audited.

deleteDialog.title: Remove SSO connection?
deleteDialog.description: Users on this domain will fall back to password login. The stored client secret is deleted.

scim.title: SCIM provisioning
scim.subtitle: Push users and groups from your identity provider with SCIM 2.0.
scim.subtitleReal: Push users from your identity provider (Okta, Azure AD) with SCIM 2.0. Enterprise plan.

status.connectedSub: SCIM connector is receiving events from Okta.
status.notConfiguredSub: Generate a token and paste it into your IdP.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.hint: Paste these into your IdP's SCIM provisioning configuration.
endpoint.bearerTokenSub: Generate a token to authenticate SCIM requests. Tokens are shown once.

syncRules.title: Sync rules
syncRules.hint: What the SCIM connector is allowed to do.
syncRules.autoCreateSub: Create accounts when the IdP sends a SCIM POST.
syncRules.autoDeactivateSub: When a user is unassigned in the IdP, deactivate their session and revoke tokens.
syncRules.syncGroupsSub: Mirror IdP group membership onto ACME teams using the mapping below.

mapping.title: Group → team mapping
mapping.hint: Map IdP group names to ACME teams. Unmapped groups are ignored.

activity.title: Recent sync activity
activity.hint: Last 6 SCIM events. Older events are in the audit log.

real.bearerTokenSub: Shown once when created. Rotate if it may be compromised — the old token stops working immediately.
real.idpNote: In your IdP, set the SCIM base URL above and paste the bearer token. Users assigned in the IdP are provisioned into this org; unassigning deprovisions them.
real.enablePrompt: Enable SCIM to get a base URL and bearer token for your identity provider. Assigned users are automatically added to this organization.
real.tokenDescription: Paste this into your IdP's SCIM connector. It can't be shown again — rotate to get a new one.
real.disableDescription: The bearer token stops working immediately and your IdP can no longer provision users. Existing members are kept.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every privileged action across the org. Retained per the Retention policy.
audit.subtitleReal: Privileged actions across the org. Retained per your plan's retention policy.

dataResidency.title: Data residency
dataResidency.subtitle: Choose where ACME data is processed and stored.

controls.title: What residency controls
controls.body: Source code, agent runs, secrets, and audit logs are stored in the selected region. Authentication metadata (email, tenant ID) lives in our global control plane. Switching regions triggers a one-time migration with a coordinated cutover.

region.title: Active region
region.hint: Click another region to request migration.

settings.title: Residency settings
settings.noCrossReplicaSub: Backups stay in the selected region only. Increases the risk of total data loss in a region-wide outage.
settings.blockExport: Block data export to other regions
settings.blockExportSub: CSV exports, agent calls, and webhook deliveries can only target endpoints in the same region.

certs.title: Compliance certifications
certs.hint: Audited by independent third parties. Reports available on request.

dataResidency.footer: Region changes are recorded in the audit log and notified to all owners and admins.

migration.title: Request migration to {{region}}?
migration.bodyPre: We'll snapshot all org data in
migration.downtime: · Estimated downtime: ~12 minutes during cutover (scheduled off-hours)
migration.cost: · One-time data transfer cost: $420 billed to current invoice
migration.sessions: · Active sessions are signed out at cutover

real.subtitle: Data retention is set by your plan and applied automatically. Higher plans keep audit history longer.
real.note: Retention is fixed by your plan and cannot be changed here. Upgrade for longer retention.

retention.title: Retention policy
retention.subtitle: How long ACME keeps each class of data before automatic deletion.

default.title: Default retention
default.hint: Applied to any data class set to “inherit default”.
default.globalSub: Number of days to retain by default. Class-level overrides take priority.

perClass.title: Per-class overrides
perClass.hint: Tighten retention for sensitive classes; loosen for compliance-required ones.

class.investigationChatsHint: Chat threads in the Intelligence stage

legalHolds.title: Legal holds
legalHolds.hint: Suspend deletion for specific scopes while litigation or investigations are open.

archive.title: Archive destination
archive.hint: Optionally archive data to your own S3 bucket before the retention deadline triggers deletion.
archive.toggleSub: Writes a one-time JSONL dump per data class to your bucket.

notes.archive: Deletions are soft for 7 days, then cryptographically shredded. Archive writes happen the night before deletion.
notes.apply: Retention changes apply to new data. Existing records inherit their original policy until next compaction.

releaseDialog.title: Release hold {{ref}}?
releaseDialog.body: Records covered by this hold will become eligible for retention-driven deletion at the next compaction window. This action is logged and notifies legal-ops.

serviceAccounts.title: Service accounts
serviceAccounts.subtitle: Machine identities for CI, scripts, and worker pools. Scope tightly; rotate tokens every 90 days.
serviceAccounts.subtitleReal: Machine identities for CI and workers. Each holds an API key scoped to this org.

empty.title: No service accounts
empty.subtitle: Create one to give CI or a worker API access.

revoke.title: Revoke "{{name}}"?
revoke.description: Any CI job or worker using this key will immediately lose access. This can't be undone.

real.subtitle: Usage this billing period against your plan limits.

usage.title: Usage
usage.subtitle: What your org has consumed in the past 30 days. Costs map to your current plan; switch in billing.

alert.title: You're projected to hit 92% of plan limits this month
alert.sub: Set a budget alert at 80%, or upgrade plans for cleaner headroom.

real.emptySubtitle: Add a domain and verify ownership via DNS TXT.
real.removeBody: This removes the verified domain from your org. You can re-add and re-verify later.

domains.title: Domains
domains.subtitle: Claim email domains for auto-join, SSO enforcement, and identity-verified invites.
domains.ssoRequiredSub: Force SAML/OIDC for accounts on this domain
domains.autoJoinSub: New verified users on this domain join automatically

verify.title: Verify {{domain}}
verify.body: Add the TXT record below to your DNS, then click verify. Propagation usually takes under 5 minutes.
